summary: A step sequencer for values: 1 to 32 steps, each a level from 0 to 100 %, played at a synced rate with swing, a glide between steps and a random amount. It moves up to 8 parameters of other machines, each with its own depth, polarity, range and curve. Use it for stepped filter patterns, rhythmic gain and pan moves, and melodic control of any value, effects included.
use_for: A 32-step pattern of values that moves any machine's parameters in time: stepped filters, rhythmic pan and gain.

parameters.name: Steps
parameters.description: How many steps the pattern has (1 … 32)
parameters.how: Sets how many steps the pattern runs before it repeats, from 1 to 32.
parameters.sound: Different step counts against the song's bars make the pattern shift against the beat.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: How long each step lasts at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Sets how long each step lasts, from 1/2 down to 1/32, straight or dotted.
parameters.sound: Faster rates make a busier pattern; dotted rates lilt against the beat.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.description: How much of each step is spent gliding to its level
parameters.how: Glides from one step's level to the next over up to a whole step.
parameters.sound: At 0 % the steps jump; higher values slide between them like a ramp.

parameters.name: Random
parameters.description: Blends each step toward a random level
parameters.how: Mixes each step's level toward a fresh random level, by this amount.
parameters.sound: At 0 % the pattern repeats exactly; at 100 % every step is random.

parameters.name: Swing
parameters.description: Delays every second step by up to 75 % of a step
parameters.how: Delays every second step, up to three quarters of a step.
parameters.sound: The pattern gets a shuffled, off-beat feel.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast a target may move: it takes at least this long to cross its whole range.
parameters.sound: A short glide keeps fast steps clean; a long one smooths them into slow sweeps.

parameters.name: Step 1
parameters.how: Sets the level of step 1, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: The targets move to this level while step 1 plays.
